title: Fetch external data, parse it, update the UI
summary: Three components: a typed HttpClient service does fetch+parse+map (testable, no UI types); an observable viewmodel owns state and a refresh command; the page just binds. Keeps parsing off the UI thread and out of code-behind.

components.description: Typed HttpClient service registered via AddHttpClient<T>: fetch, deserialize, map DTO to domain model.

steps.description: GET the endpoint with cancellation + timeout, headers-first streaming
Deserialize the response body into a DTO
Map DTO to the domain model the viewmodel binds to (domain-specific, no starting point)

components.description: Composed sub-pattern: owns bound state, busy-guarded RefreshCommand calls the service.
XAML page binds to the viewmodel's state and IsBusy; no logic in code-behind beyond BindingContext wiring.
